topic: 近一年为何说反应式VLA已死世界模型当立

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The claim contrasts reactive VLA policies with predictive, action-conditioned models; search must cover failure/recovery, physical admissibility, 4D/contact dynamics, and VLA-world-model fusion.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-reactive-vla-limit
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:reactive OR all:"error accumulation" OR all:recovery) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Test the narrow claim that reactive next-action policies break on long-horizon execution and recovery.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-fusion
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND all:"world model" AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Look for fusion rather than replacement between VLA policies and world models.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-action-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"world action model" OR all:"world-action model") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture models that jointly represent actions and predicted futures.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-action-reliability
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"action fidelity" OR all:"physics adherence" OR all:"failure optimism") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Distinguish useful predictive models from visually plausible but decision-invalid video generators.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-contact-recovery
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:tactile OR all:force OR all:contact) AND (all:recovery OR all:correction) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover contact-rich tasks where RGB-only futures are partially observable.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-benchmark-memorization
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:memorization OR all:"benchmark leakage" OR all:overfit)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Check whether standard benchmark gains overstate physical generalization.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs VLA world model robot action fidelity recovery

dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate the emerging WLA naming used by recent papers.

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): RynnVLA-002 uses the phrase unified vision-language-action and world model.
arxiv calibration (high): NORA-1.5 uses world-model- and action-based preference rewards for VLA post-training.
arxiv calibration (high): WLA-0 introduces the term world-language-action model.
